title: Glint-Horn Buccaneer discard trigger resolves above its draw ability
plain_english: The real frozen-Oracle Glint-Horn Buccaneer is attacking under P0 control and P0 can legally pay one generic and one red mana.
P0 activates Glint-Horn Buccaneer's own attack-restricted ability and discards a card as an activation cost.
The discard-triggered damage ability is put on the stack above the activated draw ability.
After both players pass, the damage trigger resolves first and deals one damage to each opponent.
State-based actions occur only after the triggered ability has completely resolved; a lethal opponent loss is recorded after STACK_OBJECT_RESOLVED.
If the game remains active, a later all-player pass sequence resolves the activated draw ability.

preconditions: P0 has an explicit card to discard
P1 has one life for the lethal-ordering case
ordered_operations: discard the selected card as a cost
put discard trigger above activated ability
required_assertions: no resolution or cessation event occurs after GAME_TERMINATED
